$description: Razer brand design tokens (Synapse 5 system). Source of truth for every generated artifact in ../generated/razer/. Sampled off the Poppin web app Figma redline pass. Cards sit DARKER than the canvas; depth comes from surface contrast, not shadows.

surface.$description: Cards and panels. Darker than canvas by design.

surface-active.$description: Selected or hovered rows and tiles.

accent.$description: Razer green. CTAs, active states, focus rings.

text-soft.$description: Subtitles, quiet labels, inactive tag dots.

ink-soft.$description: Dark label on green CTAs, per the official button SVGs.

unit.$description: Base grid step. Every spacing value is a multiple of this.

sm.$description: Button, Input, Select, hero chips, SOON tag.

lg.$description: Status chips, tile covers, editor panels.

tabs.$description: Switcher bars. The one sanctioned off-grid radius.

eyebrow.$description: Single tracking for uppercase eyebrows and micro-labels.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls. Zero hover/press feedback while disabled.
